versions.changelog:
project-anatomy 0.1.4

- Improved: Enhanced logic for filtering files by name in scripts/expense_anatomy.py.
- Updated metadata in skill.json for the new version.

- Improved documentation and usage instructions in SKILL.md, with clearer Chinese descriptions and option explanations.
- Output format and configuration examples updated for better clarity and localization.
- No code or logic changes—documentation update only.

- Added integration instructions for AGENTS.md session startup, detailing automatic use of `.anatomy.md` and periodic rescanning.
- Clarified workflow on how session startup uses the file index to avoid redundant reads.
- Updated "How to Use" section for improved clarity with focus on the `.anatomy.md` index.
- Section headers and some bullet points now use more concise Chinese descriptions.
- No change to scripts or core scanning features.

- Added Chinese translations for the name, description, and triggers, improving accessibility for Chinese-speaking users.
- Kept all core functionality, usage instructions, and options unchanged. 
- No updates to underlying features or commands; documentation only.

Initial release of the Project Anatomy skill.

- Generates a compact index of project files, summarizing contents to reduce token usage.
- Supports multiple output formats: compact, summary, and detailed table.
- Incremental scanning and excludes for efficient updates and custom filtering.
- Optional YAML config for fine-tuning depth, file size, and description length.
- Auto-refresh option ensures the anatomy index stays up-to-date automatically.
- Designed to help decide if a file needs to be opened, minimizing unnecessary reads.
